text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after full-scale 
training had begun... Due to the rain from 
the previous day, the dirt track was in 
rough shape.

A heavy track that bogs down your legs 
demands power and toughness. It is harsh 
for an Umamusume before her debut, but—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: First, I shall take it nice and easy.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Huuuuffff!!

True to her word, Gentildonna kicked off 
the ground with ease and dashed forward. 
It was hard to believe she was an 
Umamusume who hadn't even debuted yet.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*... Gentildonna-san... are 
you serious...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Having someone like that as a classmate... 
I was seriously born in the wrong era~~
choice_data_list:
(Seeing that strength, it's no wonder, 
huh...)

text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume scheduled to debut around 
the same time all seemed terrified of her 
power. Just then...—

Verxina... An Umamusume drawing attention 
all around with her immense potential. She 
is also one of Gentildonna's 
contemporaries.

Yet she seems different from the other 
girls in her year. As proof, Verxina's 
sharp gaze... was locked firmly onto 
Gentildonna.

Verxina suddenly takes off running, trying 
to pull up alongside Gentildonna. However, 
her legs seem to get caught in the heavy 
ground—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! My strength... isn't...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ... Haaaaahhh!!

—Gentildonna easily pulled away from 
Verxina and returned.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That's it for track training. See you this 
afternoon.
choice_data_list:
...Aren't you going to say something to 
Verxina?
...Aren't you going to talk to Verxina?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Of course, whenever necessary, anytime.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Your tail is covered in mud too. Let's 
use the rose shampoo today."

Even as Verxina openly displayed her 
intense rivalry, Gentildonna simply walked 
right past her without even sparing a 
glance.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ms. Gentildonna...!

Even after taking a lunch break and 
starting afternoon training—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Nnngh...! Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!! Uuuuughhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san is competing with Gentil-san 
again.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san is amazing in her own right, 
too. It's just tough having such a monster 
in the same generation...
Even when heading to the perimeter—
choice_data_list: Then I'll follow along on my bike.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. It goes without saying, but—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of watching out for 
anyone behind me. Forgive me if I leave 
you in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. This time for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

Perimeter training started with me feeling 
eyes on me from diagonally behind... 
Before long, though, I lost the luxury of 
worrying about who was behind me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!
choice_data_list:
(I knew she was fast, but... this is 
insane...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Too slow.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Why bother with such a tedious vehicle? 
Wouldn't it be faster to just run?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "I see. ...Let's take a short break."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It seems the other one has finally caught 
up as well.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, phew...

Up to this point, Gentildonna hadn't shown 
any particular interest in Verxina's 
overflowing rivalry, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be having quite a painful 
time. Why don't you just go home already?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Your drive to challenge yourself at a 
higher level is wonderful, but... it would 
be terrible if you were to get injured.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...I appreciate your concern. However..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately for you, I have not built a 
body so frail as to break from something 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Please, focus on your own training. 
Otherwise—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You're going to get overtaken, you know. 
...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Alright, break's over. I'm not going to 
wait this time.

In the end, I was left behind by 
Gentildonna along the way, but refusing to 
give up, I somehow managed to catch up—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *wheeze*...!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I gave you advice, after all. You look 
quite miserable.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

From the looks of it, they must have 
gotten locked in a duel mid-race... and 
Gentildonna simply overpowered her.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you ought to take a more honest 
look at your own capabilities?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. I have yet to defeat you even 
once.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“Still, next year on the Tiara path— when 
the real deal comes, I will overturn this 
result!”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even more than now... further and further! 
I'll hone my strength, and then...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I will shatter your arrogance on the 
grand stage! The one worthy of the Tiara 
is me!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Coming through!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ah, you have finally returned.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Starting tomorrow, I would advise 
traveling by car."

Remembering the frustration of watching 
Gentildonna's back fade from view... made 
me feel like I could keep working hard 
forever.
choice_data_list: No breaks tomorrow, we're going all out!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Heh... That will do fine. You should also—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Her, too.
choice_data_list: Verxina is... your rival, isn't she

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Whether that happens or not is up to them.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The difference in ability is plain to see. 
At this stage, there is no need to treat 
them specially.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I will not look back at her with the same 
eyes she looked at me with. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Not much longer until your debut race. 
Let us continue polishing your skills."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To become an even taller wall for those 
who seek strength—
